title: 2026 Post-NFL Draft Dynasty Rookie RB Rankings: Jadarian Price joins Jeremiyah Love at the top

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: 2026 Post-NFL Draft Dynasty Rookie RB Rankings: Jadarian Price joins Jeremiyah Love at the top
sources.description: The Cardinals made Jeremiyah Love the first running back drafted in the 2026 NFL Draft, and he'll hold the same spot in dynasty rookie drafts. After joining him in the first round, Jadarian Price now sits as the runaway RB2 of the class.
